regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. I do hope that you are well; and that by this time you are able, as once before, to smile at the seemingly desperate efforts of your really pittyable, international enemies. Pittyabl, because so frequent- ly perverters of justice and truth. No doubt you have been wondering at my silence and seemingly want of appreciation/ your generous favor of several weeks ago. I feel that, were my failure to acknowled same to continue much longer someone might even be scandalized. Not that I have failed to remember your kindness and charity or that I have not made efforts to write you; but I wanted to get something to you that would be really worth while, and that takes time. Besides all this dear Doctor; there has been something else in my mind I wanted to get it into yours: viz, to get you to realize that there is very likely something
